title: Preserve pitched notes when GP8 exports reopen in Guitar Pro
scope: Emit native-required concert and transposed pitch records without corrupting default spelling, numeric pitch authority or later public edits.
acceptance: Preserve every note occurrence, string, fret, pitch and duration through Guitar Pro reopening, including the 12-note GP3 mix-table regression.
Define and test the default-spelling reconciliation contract and representable pitch bounds.
Cover explicit spelling, capo, transposition, clef/beat octaves, natural harmonics, absolute notes and grace context with native evidence and public regressions.
Run the full semantic and repository gates and review the exact commit against native facts before closure.
exclusions: Do not silently change notes to match an AlphaTab limitation.

reproduction.instructions: Export testdata/gp3/mix-table-events.gp3 with the public probe.go bridge. Open and Save As in Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31. Native output contains 0 note occurrences instead of 12. Both ConcertPitch and TransposedPitch are required; see the hash-bound native receipt.

evidence.detail: Guitar Pro 8.1.5 build 31 native saves and UI facts, bound to exact input/output hashes. Separates the fixed sound-text bug from unresolved native pitch, position, volume and interpolation failures.

resolution: Confirmed native exporter defect. The isolated both-pitch-record experiment retains all 12 notes; its naive integration also changes default spelling semantics and breaks existing edit/context tests, so it is not a complete fix.
